lxc_7c7e0a81f3d29076.text: A table tennis table is less than three metres long, so the ball reaches you very fast.

lxc_5d652423160afb53.text: To play well, players train their legs, their fitness and their attention, and Japan's way of training young players has changed from very hard drills toward enjoyment.

lxc_bc71da32c1e86398.text: Imagine two friends watching a match.

lxc_53571f2b0006d990.text: One says, "It's just a little game on a table.

lxc_a6ee13fce7f8e11b.text: The other friend plays every week, and she smiles.

lxc_1e4697f6d4f4f4e2.text: She knows the small table is exactly the problem.

lxc_6fbf3374e69e3628.text: The table is 2.74 metres long and 1.525 metres wide.

lxc_339e4c6591a8d144.text: It stands 76 centimetres high, and a net 15.25 centimetres high divides it into two halves.

lxc_ac43981ddb04b149.text: The surface is dark and matte, which means it is not shiny.

lxc_05be3df7495c9b6e.text: That helps players see the light-coloured ball clearly.

lxc_559d0e7665eeac34.text: Now think about what that size means.

lxc_d75efd65941f6fb3.text: In tennis, players stand far apart on a big court.

lxc_9d8b0ef555d394c7.text: In table tennis, the players are close, and the ball has a very short trip.

lxc_00127e844d5fa783.text: So you have very little time between your opponent's hit and your own.

lxc_e9a1de9906baa4e5.text: This is why the sport needs fast reactions and constant attention.

lxc_443884f442b1d498.text: You also have to read the spin, because spin changes the path of the ball.

lxc_f4d8b52170af36f6.text: So the small table does not make the game easy.

lxc_aeeb0701411cc4c3.text: The table is small, but the demand on your eyes, brain and feet is big.

lxc_f2f3c7827ca1e53b.text: Because the game is so fast, many players think carefully about their racket.

lxc_f31659b0fbeee44f.text: A racket has two main parts.

lxc_7b878dfa970c6516.text: The blade is the wooden part with the handle.

lxc_aea1a911e78b6d21.text: The rubbers are the sheets on each side of the blade.

lxc_018fc7e4f681a532.text: Every player chooses a different mix, and you are the expert on your own racket.

lxc_928a2fee7e5a2077.text:
You can describe it like this:

- "My blade is ______.

lxc_5d760a45acccc870.text: - "On my forehand side I use ______, and on my backhand side I use ______."

lxc_0c6a8c4cd4afa4d5.text: - "I want my racket to help me ______, for example with spin, speed or control."

lxc_25910c074ba8e978.text: Many beginners believe that practising table tennis just means hitting the ball again and again.

lxc_939b9b4d4dab656f.text: But if the ball comes fast and wide, a perfect stroke is useless when your feet are in the wrong place.

lxc_f0d7ca9266c2a8f1.text: So serious training also builds the body.

lxc_d8a30d69ac3eed97.text: Exercises like squats and hinges build general strength.

lxc_c5fbd0baeeef9a7e.text: A hinge is a movement where you bend forward from the hips.

lxc_dfa4ff9ac00d7bbf.text: Unilateral exercises, such as split squats, train one leg at a time.

lxc_bea4b9cc4f09afb7.text: This matters because players often push off from one leg to move sideways.

lxc_7b276b6a06650869.text: Plyometric exercises are quick, jumping movements.

lxc_134685e629db51ad.text: Pogo hops and lateral bounds, which are jumps to the side, improve quick footwork.

lxc_ce6b077898303233.text: They also help the split-step, the small hop that gets a player ready to move in any direction.

lxc_6c4938b00c68526d.text: Fitness training copies the rhythm of a match.

lxc_a1c5ef942dae242d.text: Players do interval training: short, intense efforts with rest that is not quite long enough.

lxc_6ea3417e3072e211.text: That feels like match play, where you work hard, pause briefly and then work hard again.

lxc_bcccb8cf5b79b2a8.text: Players also add some easier aerobic sessions each week, like steady jogging or cycling.

lxc_a972ede928e74d62.text: These build the endurance that helps the body recover between hard efforts.

lxc_27f880362160572a.text: In other words, the arm hits the ball.

lxc_f731513102adc9d7.text: But the legs and lungs put the arm in the right place, again and again, until the last point.

lxc_23fa0b4c87592546.text: Some of Japan's best players started when they were very small children.

lxc_2a916bdf6a0893aa.text: Ai Fukuhara began playing at age 3, with early coaching from her mother.

lxc_89044cca17b6cf52.text: She practised tough drills, such as rallies of 1,000 shots.

lxc_283488f16a04f868.text: Kasumi Ishikawa also started very young.

lxc_420e50d08dfd5182.text: That story seems to give a clear lesson: start early, train hard and you will become a star.

lxc_cf0b511a754cf4cf.text: These players reached the top level, so the hard work clearly produced great skill.

lxc_b7d1af5811c17221.text: But the story has another side.

lxc_b0b6a0a4b7991297.text: Today, youth coaching in Japan places enjoyment above intense training.

lxc_683ed8969ae80f7a.text: The aim is to avoid burnout, the deep tiredness that makes people lose interest and quit.

lxc_10852e55b2d8db97.text: It also aims to prevent abuse.

lxc_af1db080af7d9bea.text: This is a clear contrast with the past, when very demanding programmes were common.

lxc_92cd0173d7e396b7.text: Ito's own early training was one of these.

lxc_c37458cff80e39a0.text: So the lesson is more balanced than "train as hard as possible."

lxc_eac921d678c16f85.text: Hard drills can build amazing control.

lxc_0f68e5a52f56c273.text: But a young player also needs to love the game, or she may not stay in it long enough to grow.

lxc_b227bffddd85e2f6.text: If you want to understand table tennis in Japan, look at its young players.

lxc_c4e98a24435106d0.text: Membership of the Japan Table Tennis Association grew a lot between 2002 and 2016.

lxc_be404aeeb3240e3a.text: About half of the members were junior high school students.

lxc_6163597cd0263218.text: In other words, the heart of the sport is in school clubs, where many people first train with a team.

lxc_79726e2dd7bcd4ed.text: One reason for the growth was a famous success.

lxc_800951795a533048.text: Ai Fukuhara's success in 2004 made table tennis more popular in Japan.

lxc_02cb13f36dba5399.text: After that, people worked to raise public awareness of the sport and to aim higher in competition.

lxc_6d024afc63e03430.text: Here we can see a useful connection.

lxc_da1396e1bbe90e52.text: A star inspires children, and children join school clubs.

lxc_56482311ca080e36.text: Strong school clubs then produce more players, and some of them may become the next stars.

lxc_53b9379743502f74.text: When that happens, the circle starts again.

lxc_d0c90e0098bfb556.text: Adult club life is a different story, and every club is different.

lxc_b74af2f93439ffa5.text: Others stop for years and then come back.

lxc_38c7c9a89fa580b1.text: Your own experience is the best guide here.

lxc_8d41e9204917331d.text:
To describe your adult club, you can use these frames:

- "I play at ______, usually on ______, with ______."

lxc_c4d59f45ec560b97.text: - "A normal practice at my club includes ______."

lxc_cb901e6d69b97a5b.text: Now, in my adult club, matches are ______."

lxc_050b4188adda5aaa.text: A table tennis match is not one long contest.

lxc_1a3dfe5f43391250.text: It is made of separate games.

lxc_69018ef6e4f1018e.text: Matches are usually best of five or best of seven games.

lxc_deadaaac3280bfe8.text: The winner is the first player to win most of the games.

lxc_d3a401427c77d08b.text: In a best-of-five match, that means three games.

lxc_6952004b2b16ca46.text: In a best-of-seven match, it means four.

lxc_0fea227dd4abc356.text: This structure changes how players think.

lxc_eb8db7aa9b350221.text: Losing one game is not the end.

lxc_a33796f5ce9fe27d.text: A player can lose the first game, change her plan and still win the match.

lxc_4eff1ae67637e959.text: So the match tests your ability to adjust, not only your skill.

lxc_0a14ec3e5d64d0b2.text: Players also change ends, which means they move to the other side of the table.

lxc_fc13ec8b6decfc32.text: In the final game, they switch when one player reaches five points.

lxc_9fe5ee77d11c79c5.text: This way, neither player keeps one side for the whole deciding game.

lxc_5793b41e5f3d951a.text: Doubles matches mostly follow the singles rules, but there are some exceptions.
